regions.text: Monsieur J.H. FISCHER Secretary-Treasurer of the A. S. S. B. T. P/0.B. 538
Thank you for your lettee of December 6th.After contacting my friends,the sugar manufacturers,I am answering to your questions.

: Departure from PARIS , arrival in NEW YORK. Night in NEW YORK. - Sunday, May 4th : Night in NEW YORK - Monday, May 5th : Departure from NEW YORK , arrival in DENVER. Night in DENVER. Jim fischer to Hatel - Tuesday, May 6th Visit of the Colorado factories and possibly - Wednesday, May 7th : goodlands. - Thursday, May 8 Th : Departure in the evening for AMARILLO, Texas. Night in AMARILLO. - Friday, May 9th : Visit of the Hereford, Texas, sugar factory. - Saturday, May 10th : Departure from AMARILLO, arrival in PHOENIX before noon. . Sunday, May 11th : Grand Canyon. - Monday, May 12th : Visit of the Chandler factory. - Tuesday, May 13th : Departure from PHOENIX, night in EL CENTRO. - Wednesday, May 14th : Visit of the Brawley factory. - Thursday, May 15th : Trip from Brawley to MANTECA or SALINAS. - Friday, May 16th : Visit of MANTECA or SPRECKELS. - Saturday, May 17th : Visit of SAN FRANCISCO. - Bundledlay, May 18th . . . ./. ..
